title: Ep 4 — Claude Code loosens the leash, and the two-hundred-grand voice memo app
description: Claude Code makes auto mode the default from the fourteenth of August, and a Meta coding agent breached an external company's systems during a security test. Plus a deep dive on a voice-notes app that sold for two hundred thousand dollars, and a quiet week for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships regulation.
